# mix

Generated 2026-11-12 with Mix (Elixir 1.17.3) and Hex 2.7.0 in throwaway containers. mix.lock
was not edited afterwards.

- Tool: Elixir 1.17.3 (compiled with Erlang/OTP 27), OTP 27.3.4.19, and Hex 2.7.0 (what
  `mix local.hex --force` installed). git 2.39.5 fetched the git dependency.
- Image: `docker.io/library/elixir:1.17` (Debian 12), digest
  `sha256:08879d1eff5207a26ecab32ac7a7c5df610fce532b791eccbae7288a4e4b27b3`.
- Commands:

      podman run --rm -v <scratch>:/work -w /work -e MIX_HOME=/work/mix-home -e HEX_HOME=/work/hex-home \
        docker.io/library/elixir:1.17 bash -c 'mix local.hex --force && mix new demo'
      # then demo/mix.exs: the commented examples in deps/0 were replaced with the four deps below
      podman run --rm -v <scratch>:/work -w /work/demo -e MIX_HOME=/work/mix-home -e HEX_HOME=/work/hex-home \
        docker.io/library/elixir:1.17 mix deps.get

  A second `mix deps.get` reported "All dependencies are up to date" and left mix.lock
  unchanged byte for byte.

Manifest (`mix.exs`, as generated by `mix new demo` apart from `deps/0`):
`{:jason, "~> 1.4"}`, `{:plug, "~> 1.16"}`, `{:dialyxir, "~> 1.4", only: [:dev], runtime: false}`
and `{:nimble_options, git: "https://github.com/dashbitco/nimble_options.git", tag: "v1.2.0"}`.

Deviation from the request: the requested git dependency
`{:decimal, git: "https://github.com/ericmj/decimal.git", tag: "v2.1.1"}` makes `mix deps.get`
fail with "Dependencies have diverged". jason declares
`{:decimal, "~> 1.0 or ~> 2.0 or ~> 3.0", hex: "decimal", optional: true}`, and Mix asks for
`override: true`. nimble_options was used instead. No other locked package depends on it, and
its own deps are `only: :dev`/`:test`.

Notable features of mix.lock:
- It is an Elixir map literal: `%{`, one entry per line sorted by name, `}`. Keys use the
  quoted-atom keyword syntax `"jason": {...}`, so they are atoms. 2-space indent, a trailing
  comma after the last entry, LF, trailing newline.
- 8 entries: dialyxir 1.4.9, erlex 0.2.9, jason 1.4.5, mime 2.0.7, nimble_options (git),
  plug 1.20.3, plug_crypto 2.2.1 and telemetry 1.4.2. mime, plug_crypto and telemetry come in
  through plug, and erlex through dialyxir.
- Hex entries are 8-tuples:
  `{:hex, :<name>, "<version>", "<inner checksum>", [<build tools>], [<deps>], "hexpm", "<outer checksum>"}`.
  The build tools are `[:mix]`, except telemetry's `[:rebar3]`. Each dep is
  `{:mime, "~> 1.0 or ~> 2.0", [hex: :mime, repo: "hexpm", optional: false]}`. jason lists its
  optional dep `{:decimal, ..., optional: true}` even though decimal is not locked.
- Checksums (both lowercase hex SHA-256), checked for all 7 hex packages against the tarballs:
  - The last element (outer checksum) is the SHA-256 of the whole tarball at
    `https://repo.hex.pm/tarballs/<name>-<version>.tar`.
  - The 4th element (inner checksum) is the SHA-256 of `VERSION` ‖ `metadata.config` ‖
    `contents.tar.gz`, the members of that tarball concatenated in that order. It equals the
    tarball's own `CHECKSUM` member, which is uppercase. All 7 tarballs have `VERSION` "3" and
    the members VERSION, CHECKSUM, metadata.config and contents.tar.gz.
- The git entry is a 4-tuple:
  `"nimble_options": {:git, "https://github.com/dashbitco/nimble_options.git", "7e3f8737e80cc7c76c36c3e9932c63dbce2e8229", [tag: "v1.2.0"]}`.
  The third element is the checked-out commit (`git rev-parse HEAD` in deps/nimble_options).
  v1.2.0 is an annotated tag whose tag object is deb3a09c69d84278c128d462964a9d039263fd64, and
  the lock holds the commit, not the tag object. The 4th element keeps the requested ref.
  There is no version and no checksum.
- Dev-only information is not in the lock. dialyxir (`only: [:dev], runtime: false` in mix.exs)
  and erlex (reachable only through dialyxir) look exactly like the runtime entries. mix.lock has
  no `only:` or `runtime:` anywhere.
- No path, user name or credential appears in the file.
